sections.content: How many people are "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors"?

16,740 people

were counted on the census as "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors co-ordinate the activities and resources of hairdressing salons, beauty treatment and similar establishments.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors", 17.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors" included:

  • early education and childcare services managers
  • sales accounts and business development managers
  • financial accounts managers

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors" there were more women than men (79.8% compared with 20.2%).

This means "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 20.3% and women made up 79.7% of "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors" included:

  • registered nurse practitioners
  • psychotherapists and cognitive behaviour therapists
  • librarians

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "hairdressing and beauty salon managers and proprietors", 8.6% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (62% compared with 38%).

They are also more likely to be self-employed (57%) than an employee (43%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Leeds, this is in the region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
